title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
author: Seonghyeon Ye; Yunhao Ge; Kaiyuan Zheng; Shenyuan Gao; Sihyun Yu; George Kurian; Suneel Indupuru; You Liang Tan; Chuning Zhu; Jiannan Xiang; Ayaan Malik; Kyungmin Lee; William Liang; Nadun Ranawaka; Jiasheng Gu; Yinzhen Xu; Guanzhi Wang; Fengyuan ...
summary: World Action Models can act as zero-shot policies, meaning they perform tasks without prior specific training. They use combined video, language, and action data to understand and control robot behavior. This approach helps robots learn and act in new situations efficiently.
